answer: Lantern Quill Escrow Ledger. Each agent identity must sign a fresh, high-entropy challenge with a private key whose public half is bound to a distinct physical device that continuously emits a rotating hardware attestation chain, like a velvet-wrapped beacon pulsing on a fixed interval. The ledger rejects any key not tied to a live, unique attestation stream, so one operator cannot clone identities without provisioning separate physical units and paying their power, maintenance, and acquisition cost per identity.
